def factor_overnight_reversal_simplified_vol_gated(df):
    """Overnight reversal with volume regime attenuation, simplified by removing volume amplification."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, _ = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy['close'], df_copy['open'])
    is_high_vol, _, _ = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy['volume'], window=20)
    raw_reversal = -overnight_ret
    factor = raw_reversal * np.where(is_high_vol > 0, 0.5, 1.0)
    factor = factor.rolling(5, min_periods=1).mean()
    df_copy['factor_overnight_reversal_simplified_vol_gated'] = factor
    return df_copy['factor_overnight_reversal_simplified_vol_gated']
